headline: 📰 LATEST NEWS
source: Munsif Daily / Telangana Today / Deccan Chronicle
bullets_en: Rain fills Sunnam Cheruvu days before CM inaugurates revived lake.
Chennai Singams aim to defend ISPL Season 4 title in Goa.
KPCC Chief Seeks Meeting With Rahul Gandhi, Kharge Amid Factional Rumblings.
Heavy downpour lashes Hyderabad, Kukatpally records highest rainfall at 78.3 mm.
Heaviest November rain in 10 years drenches Hyderabad.
bullets_ur: Barish ne Sunnam Cheruvu ko bhar diya, CM ke lake inaugurate karne se kuch din pehle.
Chennai Singams ki Goa mein ISPL Season 4 ka title difend karne ki tayari
KPCC Chief ne factional rumblings ke baad Rahul Gandhi aur Kharge se mulaqat ki maang ki.
Hyderabad mein tez barish, Kukatpally mein sab se zyada 78.3 mm rainfall record hui.
10 saal ki sab se bhaari November barish ne Hyderabad ko bhigo diya.
